advisory: This record measures what the advisory semantic review cost and what its artifacts returned. A returned probability is a model answer, never an accuracy figure; a question no request asked is counted as not asked, never as a correct negative.

fieldSources.runs[].artifact: the sidecar path, and a sha256 over that file's own bytes, so a figure is bound to the artifact it was read from
fieldSources.runs[].context: the stored report's own #context (repository, prNumber, headSha, mergeBaseSha, evidenceProfile)
fieldSources.runs[].wallClock: the stored report's own #startedAt and #completedAt, stated as the run's own span
fieldSources.runs[].usage: the stored report's own #usage block plus #scope.cacheHits
fieldSources.runs[].ruleCoverage: scan.json #signals[].{path,ruleId,missingEvidence}, #scope.requestOrder[].ruleIds, and #scope.unassessed[].reason; not computable for a verification run, which assesses findings rather than rule applicability
fieldSources.runs[].evidenceCompleteness: scan.json #signals[].missingEvidence and #scope.truncated[].reason; verification.json #findingAssessments[].disposition; an evaluation outcome has no truncation ledger
fieldSources.runs[].outcomeAccounting: scan.json #scope.states as published, and #scope.{excluded,unassessed} re-derived here by the same function the report validator holds the published block to
fieldSources.runs[].signalOutcome: scan.json #signals[].disposition, and .agents/review-bundles/<pr>-<head>/dossier.json #signalDispositions or a literal semantic-signal token
fieldSources.runs[].labelledExpectationHeld: the evaluation runner's own #expectedConcernHeld per fixture: a count of labelled expectations that held, over the rules under test, never an accuracy figure
fieldSources.acrossRuns: the sum of the same figure over every run whose artifact carried it
fieldSources.acrossRuns.wallClockMs: the sum of the runs' own spans, over the runs that recorded one
fieldSources.acrossRuns.repeatedWarnings: the same (ruleId, path) fired on more than one distinct head of one pull request, keyed by repository and pull request number
fieldSources.acrossRuns.evidence.limitationsByText: each run artifact's own #limitations, one entry per distinct text with the number of runs that recorded it
fieldSources.acrossRuns.ruleCoverage.notAskedByRule: the same rule set the coverage figures count, read once for the whole set rather than repeated per run
fieldSources.acrossRuns.signals.byRule: each run artifact's own #signals[].ruleId, counted across the set
fieldSources.acrossRuns.labelledExpectations: the evaluation runner's own #expectedConcernHeld count over the fixtures it ran
fieldSources.skippedArtifacts: artifacts present on disk that the report validator or the dossier reader refused, with its message

sources.note: retained artifacts from earlier work in this checkout, not a controlled experiment; each run is the pipeline run that wrote the artifact
